name: vuesp.kc868-a4
summary: KinCony KC868-A4 controller with 4 relays, 4 inputs, ADC/DAC, RS232, 433 MHz and IR.
description:
## Vuesp KC868-A4

ESP32 firmware for the KinCony KC868-A4 board. Four relays and four opto-isolated inputs are connected directly to GPIO, with four ADC channels, two 0-10 V DAC outputs, RS232, DS18B20, 433 MHz and IR interfaces.

ScriptRunner exposes `input` and `output` functions, and the dashboard contains controls for all four channels. The project includes the standard Vuesp Wi-Fi setup, LittleFS, GPIO and OTA features.
